category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: The AWS Bedrock Chat Model node allows you use LLM models utilising AWS Bedrock platform

parameters.name: Using AWS Guardrails
parameters.description: Guardrails let your organization enforce content and safety policies on model invocations. The guardrail must exist in the same AWS region as the model. The Guardrail option has these fields:
options: Guardrail Identifier: The ID or full ARN of the guardrail to apply

options.name: maxTokensToSample
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion

options.name: temperature
options.description: Controls randomness: Lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.

options.name: topP
options.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling: 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature b

options.name: maxRetries
options.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt when a request fails

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time a request is allowed to take in milliseconds. Increase this for long generations; set to 0 to disable.

options.name: additionalModelRequestFields
options.description: Model-family-specific inference parameters passed through as JSON (e.g. Claude top_k/thinking, Nova inferenceConfig/

options.name: latency
options.description: Latency optimization mode for the request. "Optimized" can reduce response time for supported models and regions.
